used.how: the chain's bfloat8_b output differed from ttnn.typecast by one step until the compute set bfp8_pack_precise (plus a define, the kernel cache key omits the flag)
chain kernels take their block split from 2 common args and the core's (x, y) (ckv_share pattern), no per-core runtime args
chain op builds one program per mesh range (no per-coordinate programs)
kept bf16 cos / sin tables at the op's default HiFi4 fp32 DEST; the chain compute repeats that arithmetic
the in-process on/off identity test patches settings.get rather than the environment (settings frozen at load)
kept the bf16 intermediate packs of the stock rope arithmetic (packer ties-away) so the fused result is bit-identical rather than re-deriving with an SFPU round
bf16 operands through the trans-mat matmul at HiFi4 are exact; no precision change needed in the fused rope

missing: sparse_sdpa's q / output tile is 32 heads of one token, RoPE's and wo_a's is 32 tokens of one head: a TILE in / out option on sparse_sdpa cannot remove the to_layout / untilize; the ROW_MAJOR tensor is the transposition, so the fused rope tilizes / untilizes in its compute

descriptor-adapter ops: a factory-level override_runtime_arguments(Program&, ...) avoids the binding fast path's bail on an output_tensor carried in tensor_args (now DS41-187); the detect-smuggled-rta hook then needs '// smuggled-rta-ok' on the address args

overseer.evidence: no padding / duplication: the chain op reads each head in place (input_heads), tilizes / untilizes in compute; fork extended with new options and its own tests (tests/unit/test_chain.py)
